subject: gl.filter.maf different result in dartR and dartR.base

messages.author: 377f4a75163fc6dc
messages.subject: gl.filter.maf different result in dartR and dartR.base
parts:
Hello, 

I was re-running some code and found that I was getting different results to last time using the 'gl.filter.maf' function. 

The following code reproduces the issue on my Windows 10 system with dartR 2.9.7, dartR.base 0.65, and R 4.3.1:

test1 <- dartR::gl.filter.maf(dartR.data::testset.gl, threshold = 0.01)
test2 <- dartR.base::gl.filter.maf(dartR.data::testset.gl, threshold = 0.01)

test1 has 65 SNPs, while test2 has 68.

Wondering if this is an intentional change or an error, and which one I should be using? 

Kind regards, 
Mandi

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: gl.filter.maf different result in dartR and dartR.base
parts:
Hi Mandi,

 

Thank you for reporting this issue. The correct version of gl.filter.maf is in dartR not dartR.base. Please use the gl.filter.maf from dartR. We will implement the correct version in dartR.base ASAP.

 

 

Cheers,

Luis
